verdict.reasons: Core defect: the required technical evidence is absent or misrepresented. The image shows a rigid, metallic pipe/lateral instead of a continuous thin flattened installed drip tape, which contradicts the article's focus on post-installation drip tape monitoring and maintenance. The carton is positioned near the line rather than in the specified dry-soil island, and the required dark wet-soil strip contrast with lighter dry soil outside the root zone is not clearly visible. Neutral soil is present instead of the required seedlings. The product packaging is authentic and readable, with the required watermark, and no unrelated products or people are present.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
